blocks.text: Setting up your nonprofit workspace in Notion on Mac

Your Mac is the command center for your nonprofit work. Start by installing the Notion desktop app for macOS 13 or later. This ensures you have access to global search via ⌘ P and offline capabilities. Create a master dashboard page to hold your core databases. Use the / command to insert a linked view of your tasks or a gallery for donor profiles.

items: Create a master database for all your grant applications.
Add a date property to track upcoming deadlines.
Use the status property to mark stages like Pending or Awarded.
Set up a gallery view to see project photos and impact reports.

blocks.text: Managing donor relationships and grant cycles

Tracking donors requires precision. Create a database with properties for contact info, last donation date, and communication history. If you need to import data from a CSV file, use the Import option in the sidebar. When you are deep into grant writing, use the ⌘ ⇧ L shortcut to lock your page and prevent accidental edits to your narrative.
Faster workflows with Lazur on your Mac

Lazur works alongside Notion to reduce your admin tax. When you need to find a specific page, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to point it out. If you are stuck on how to create a formula for your grant budget, ask Lazur to explain the steps. Lazur does not edit your data, but it guides you through the Notion interface so you spend less time clicking menus.
Use the fn key to dictate your meeting notes directly into a Notion block. This is helpful when you are fresh out of a site visit and need to capture details before they fade.
blocks.title: Dictate your notes

blocks.text: Organizing volunteer schedules and project tasks

Program coordinators often juggle multiple calendars. Use a Kanban board for project tasks to see progress at a glance. For volunteer shifts, a calendar view is more effective. You can switch views by clicking the view name at the top of your database. If you have many volunteers, use filters to show only the tasks assigned to specific people.

Many coordinators clutter their sidebar with too many pages. Keep your top-level pages minimal. Use sub-pages to nest related content. If you find yourself searching for files constantly, use ⌘ P to open the search bar. Do not rely on deep nesting; it makes navigation harder. Instead, use breadcrumbs and linked databases to surface content where you need it.

If you are struggling with a specific feature, press ⇧ ? to see the full list of keyboard shortcuts. This is the fastest way to learn how to move blocks or change text styles without leaving your keyboard. For more complex setups, like embedding a Google Sheet, check the official Notion help pages to ensure you have the right permissions set up.

faq.question: Does Lazur edit my Notion pages for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is a voice assistant that guides you, points at interface elements, and dictates text. It does not click buttons or modify your data within Notion.

faq.question: What is the best way to track grant deadlines in Notion?
faq.answer: Create a database with a Date property and use the Calendar view. You can also add a Status property to track your progress from proposal to final report.

faq.question: Can I use Notion offline on my Mac?
faq.answer: Notion requires an internet connection for most features, but the desktop app allows you to view pages you have recently visited while offline. Always ensure you are on the latest version of the app.

faq.question: How do I find my Notion shortcuts?
faq.answer: Press ⇧ ? on your keyboard while in the Notion desktop app to open the complete list of available shortcuts.

faq.question: Is Notion free for nonprofits?
faq.answer: Notion offers specific plans for nonprofits. Check their pricing page to see if you qualify for discounts or free access for your team.
